title: e2e no-flash test and dark visual QA sweep
description: Depends on ce-5hb.2, .4, .5, .6. (2) Run the app with FRIGATE_MOCK=true, screenshot every route listed in spec acceptance #1 in dark at 390px and 1280px into the scratchpad, plus open Dialog/Sheet/DropdownMenu. Report any component with hard-coded light-only colours; fix ONLY via existing tokens (no new values, no dark: variants). Anything needing a new token or design judgement → stop and report back. acceptance_criteria: e2e passes; screenshots reviewed; no light-only leftovers.

title: Theme runtime: themeMode.ts helpers + useTheme store
description: Create src/features/shared/hooks/themeMode.ts (pure): type ThemeMode='light'|'dark'|'auto'; THEME_STORAGE_KEY='theme'; THEME_COLORS={light:'#eef6ff',dark:'#0b1424'} as const; parseThemeMode(raw: string|null): ThemeMode (unknown→'auto'); resolveThemeMode(mode, prefersDark): 'light'|'dark'; nextThemeMode(mode): light→dark→auto→light; applyResolvedTheme(resolved, doc=document): html gets exactly one of classes light/dark, style.colorScheme=resolved, meta[name=theme-color] content=THEME_COLORS[resolved] (no-op if meta missing). Create src/features/shared/hooks/useTheme.ts: module-level store with useSyncExternalStore (server snapshot 'auto'); returns {mode, resolved, setTheme, cycleTheme}; on first mount reads localStorage (try/catch → 'auto'); setTheme writes storage (try/catch) and applies; while mode==='auto' subscribe to matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') 'change' and re-apply; unsubscribe when leaving auto/unmount. No browser globals during render (see CLAUDE.md SSR rules; invoke tanstack-start-boundaries skill). Reference the deleted predecessor for shape only: git show 3bbef27^:src/features/shared/hooks/useTheme.ts (drop palette/themeColor coupling). Tests: themeMode.test.ts exhaustive; useTheme.test.ts with renderHook + a matchMedia stub (two hook instances share state; persistence; auto follows a simulated change event; theme-color meta updates). Gates: bun run test, bun run lint, bun x tsc --noEmit. TDD red→green→refactor. Spec: docs/specs/glassmorphism-dark-mode.md.
acceptance_criteria: All helpers + hook tested; no window access at module scope or render.

title: Blocking theme init script in __root.tsx (no flash)
description: Depends on ce-5hb.3. In src/routes/__root.tsx add THEME_INIT_SCRIPT, an IIFE string built from THEME_STORAGE_KEY and THEME_COLORS (import from #/features/shared/hooks/themeMode) via JSON.stringify — constants only. It: reads localStorage[key] (validate light|dark|auto else auto), resolves with matchMedia, sets html class light/dark + style.colorScheme + theme-color meta content; whole body in try/catch. Inject as the first <script> in <head> (via head scripts or dangerouslySetInnerHTML in RootDocument, matching how the predecessor did it: git show 3bbef27^:src/routes/__root.tsx). Add suppressHydrationWarning to <html>. Keep the static theme-color meta default '#eef6ff' and status-bar 'default'. Tests in src/routes/__root.test.tsx: the script string contains the storage key and both colours; evaluating it in jsdom with localStorage theme=dark and a stubbed matchMedia adds class dark and sets the meta; with garbage stored value + prefersDark=false gives light. Gates: bun run test, bun run lint, bun x tsc --noEmit. TDD red→green→refactor. Spec: docs/specs/glassmorphism-dark-mode.md.
acceptance_criteria: Hard reload with theme=dark shows no light frame (verified later in ce-5hb.8).

title: Split fill/text colour roles and tokenise remaining literals in styles.css
description: Prerequisite for dark mode; NO visual change in light. In src/styles.css layer-1 :root add primitives (exact light values in spec 'Role split' table): --gl-accent-fill #1856ff, --gl-accent-fill-hover #1448e0, --gl-danger-fill #c81e3a, --gl-surface-solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94), --gl-overlay rgba(16, 32, 51, 0.4), --gl-blob-1 rgba(79, 140, 255, 0.45), --gl-blob-2 rgba(24, 86, 255, 0.28), --gl-elev-raised-hover 0 28px 88px rgba(79, 140, 255, 0.26). Rewire: --primary → var(--gl-accent-fill); --destructive → var(--gl-danger-fill); @theme add --color-primary-hover: var(--gl-accent-fill-hover) and --color-overlay: var(--gl-overlay); REMOVE --color-brand-strong-hover. The three glass utilities' @supports-not fallback → var(--gl-surface-solid). body::before gradients → var(--gl-blob-1)/var(--gl-blob-2). .event-card:hover box-shadow → var(--gl-elev-raised-hover). src/features/shared/components/ui/button.tsx default variant hover:bg-brand-strong-hover → hover:bg-primary-hover. ui/dialog.tsx and ui/sheet.tsx overlay bg-(--gl-fg)/40 → bg-overlay. Update existing tests that assert old class names. New test src/styles.tokens.test.ts (node env, reads styles.css as text): every rgba(/#hex literal outside a ':root {…}' or ':root.dark {…}' block must be in an allow-list of the image scrim/scanline rgba(0, 0, 0, …) values. Gates: bun run test, bun run lint, bun x tsc --noEmit. TDD red→green→refactor. Spec: docs/specs/glassmorphism-dark-mode.md.
acceptance_criteria: Light renders identically; no bg-brand-strong-hover or bg-(--gl-fg) left in src; tokens test passes.

title: Move inline clip player into a collapsed accordion under the snapshot
description:

- Player block moves below the snapshot block.
- Wrap the player in a native <details>/<summary> accordion (no ARIA needed; works on iOS Safari out of the box).

- Lazy mount: <EventClipPlayer> is NOT rendered until the accordion opens for the first time, so no clip fetch happens on page load.
- Latch on first open: once opened, the player stays mounted even after the user collapses the accordion, so re-expanding is instant and any playback position is preserved.
- When has_clip=false: no accordion at all.

title: Bun-runtime streaming smoke test (Phase 2 prerequisite)
description:
Manual verification step that validates getEventClipStream's Range + Content-Length behavior survives the Bun/Nitro runtime end-to-end BEFORE the clip proxy refactor (ce-j2v) commits.

## Procedure
1. Spin up dev server (bun run dev).
2. Spin up a minimal scratch route returning getEventClipStream directly.
3. curl with Range: bytes=0-1023 against /api/events/{id}/clip.
4. Assert: 206 status, Content-Range and Content-Length: 1024 headers, body length is 1024 bytes.
5. curl without Range. Assert: 200 with Accept-Ranges: bytes and Content-Length matching full mp4.

## Outcome
- PASS: continue with ce-j2v as planned.
- FAIL: fall back to synthetic Range slicing on a buffered response. Update Phase 2 plan before continuing.

Record curl invocations and outputs in a comment on this task.

## Spec
- AC22
- docs/specs/inline-event-clip-playback.md > 'Constraints' bullet about Content-Length / Range
close_reason:
PASS. Smoke against a throwaway /api/smoke/clip-stream route with FRIGATE_MOCK=true:

Full GET (no Range):
  Status 200, Content-Type video/mp4, Content-Length 24, Accept-Ranges bytes.
  Body length: 24 bytes. First 8 bytes 00000018 66747970 = mp4 ftyp box.

Range GET (Range: bytes=0-3):
  Status 206, Content-Range 'bytes 0-3/24', Content-Length 4, Content-Type video/mp4.
  Body length: 4 bytes. Hex 00000018 = first 4 bytes of upstream mp4.

Conclusion: Bun/Nitro preserves ReadableStream body and forwards
Content-Length / Content-Range / Accept-Ranges headers end-to-end. AC22
verified. Safe to proceed with ce-j2v (proxy refactor) as planned —
R1/R2 fallback (synthetic Range slicing) is not needed.

Scratch route deleted.

title: Inline event clip playback with bounding-box overlay
description:
Add inline video playback for event clips on the camera event detail page, plus a toggle to overlay Frigate's detection bounding box on the still snapshot.

## Why
Currently src/features/camera-details/components/EventSnapshot.tsx only renders the static snapshot.jpg, and clip support stops at download. Frigate already serves clip.mp4 (via getEventClip in src/features/shared/server/frigate/client.ts:181-188) and the snapshot endpoint accepts bbox=true + timestamp params (GetEventMediaParams in src/features/shared/server/frigate/types.ts:305-312).

Users currently have to open Frigate directly to see motion in context — this closes that gap.

## In scope
- HTML5 video player on the event detail page that streams the proxied clip with native controls (iOS-friendly)
- Bounding-box overlay toggle on the still snapshot (snapshot.jpg?bbox=true)
- Graceful fallback when has_clip is false
- Cross-platform: must work on iOS Safari standalone PWA and Android Chrome
- Maintain existing snapshot proxy auth pattern

## Out of scope
- Timeline scrubbing strip with keyframes (future epic)
- Multi-event clip stitching
- 24/7 recording playback

## Spec
Detailed Gherkin scenarios, architecture notes, and acceptance criteria live in docs/specs/inline-event-clip-playback/.
close_reason: All Phase 1 + Phase 2 child tasks complete. Inline clip player and bbox toggle shipped. ce-4pb desktop Chromium verified; iOS/Android accepted out-of-band by maintainer.
